summary: Held through the first dip (-6.25pts, 1m bar recovering off its low) since that was within normal leg noise. Bailed at t=2m when px hit -34pts, a 101% giveback of the leg's typical amplitude with 1m lambda_hat significantly negative at all three lookbacks (12/21/30) and both HA and PROPP fires flipping against the position simultaneously -- that combination (giveback exceeding prior swing size + sig negative momentum + convergent adverse fires) read as a genuine breakdown, not a pullback. Next time I'd watch for the giveback-vs-amp ratio crossing ~100% together with multi-window lambda agreement as the earliest reliable wrong-direction tell, rather than waiting for it to compound further.
